description: Raise a claim with supporting documents. Two parts: 'claim' (JSON string) and 'files' (one or more JPEG/PNG/PDF, max 5MB each). Policy must be ACTIVE; claimAmount <= remaining coverage; incidentDate within policy period.

claim.claimReason: Rear bumper dent in parking lot collision

multipartParts.files: attach e.g. incident_photo.jpg (at least one file)

curlExample: curl -X POST http://localhost:8081/api/claims/raise -H "Authorization: Bearer <customer-token>" -F "claim={\"policyId\":2,\"claimAmount\":45000,\"claimReason\":\"Rear bumper dent\",\"incidentDate\":\"2026-08-01\"}" -F "files=@incident_photo.jpg"

description: Get claim by id (seeded 1-3). No body.
Claim status history / audit trail (claim 1 has 3 transitions). Query: ?pageNumber=0&pageSize=10&sortBy=id&sortDirection=desc
Move a SUBMITTED claim to UNDER_REVIEW. Use claimId=3 (CLM-2N4P6Q9R). No body.
Assign an UNDER_REVIEW claim to the current staff member. No body.
Review and recommend. recommendedStatus must be RECOMMENDED_FOR_APPROVAL or RECOMMENDED_FOR_REJECTION. Claim must be assigned to the caller.

body.remarks: All documentation verified. Claim is valid.

description: Final decision. recommendedStatus must be APPROVED or REJECTED. Claim must be in RECOMMENDED_FOR_APPROVAL/REJECTION.
